Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

ti=G['Test input']

    # line rows: rows 2-6 and the seed rows 7-8; row1 (the 5-bar) unchanged

    base=r
    pat=base[7:10]   # pattern right of sep
    line=base[:6]    # marker + gap before sep
    row=list(line)+list(pat)
    # tile pattern into the gap region (cols1-5), anchored right of marker, left of sep
    tiled=[]
    for c in range(1,6):
        tiled.append(pat[(c-1)*0 + ((c-1)%(len(pat)))])
    out[i]=[line[0]]+tiled+[list(pat)]+[0]*(10-(i==i))
print(json.dumps(out))

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # separator: longest contiguous single-color vertical run (>=2 cells)
    best=None
    for c in range(W):
        rs=[r for r in range(H) if g[r][c]!=0]
        if len(rs)<2: continue
        v=g[rs[0]][c]
        ok=all(g[r][c]==v for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1))
        if not ok: continue
        L=max(rs)-min(rs)+1
        if best is None or L>best[0]: best=(L,v,c)
    L,v,sep=best
    lines=[i for i in range(H) if g[i][sep]==v]
    # find rows containing content right of sep below the lowest line row -> pattern block
    P={}
    s=max(lines)+1
    while s<H and not any(x!=0 for x in g[s][sep+1:]): s+=1
    top=s
    while s<H:
        p=g[s][sep+1:]
        key=(s-top)%2
        P.setdefault(key,None)
        if P[key] is None: P[key]=p[:]
        s+=1
    out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        row=list(g[i])
        if i in lines and P:
            n=(i-top)%2
            for kk,x in enumerate(P[n]):
                row[sep+kk]=x   # overwrite starting from column after marker/left region? demo4: pattern starts left of sep!

        out.append(row)

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    best=None
    for c in range(W):
        rs=[r for r in range(H) if g[r][c]!=0]
        if len(rs)<2: continue
        v=g[rs[0]][c]
        ok=all(g[r][c]==v for r in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1))
        if not ok: continue
        L=max(rs)-min(rs)+1
        if best is None or L>best[0]: best=(L,v,c,(min(rs),max(rs)))
    L,v,sep,(lo,hi)=best
    lines=list(range(lo,hi+1))
    P={}
    top=max(lines)+1
    while top<H and not any(x!=0 for x in g[top][sep+1:]): top+=1
    s=top
    while s<H:
        p=g[s][sep+1:]
        key=(s-top)%2
        if key not in P: P[key]=p[:]
        s+=1
    out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        row=list(g[i])
        if row[sep]==v and P:
            n=(i-top)%2
            for kk,x in enumerate(P[n]):
                if 0<=sep-kk-1<W: row[sep-kk-1]=x
        elif g[i][:sep] and i not in lines and not (row[sep]==v):
            # rows like the seed block: keep left-of-sep content, replace right side with pattern
            pass
        out.append(row)
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    best=None
    for c in range(W):
        rs=[r for r in range(H) if g[r][c]!=0]

        L=max(rs)-min(rs)+1
        if best is None or L>best[0]: best=(L,v,c,(min(rs),max(rs)))
    L,v,sep,(lo,hi)=best
    lines=list(range(lo,hi+1))
    top=max(lines)+1
    while top<H and not any(x!=0 for x in g[top][sep+1:]): top+=1
    P={}

            for kk,x in enumerate(P[n]):
